basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old gamer from Austin, Texas. I've been into RPGs since I was a kid, with Dragon Quest being one of my all-time favorites. Besides gaming, I have a knack for numbers and work as a data analyst. My evenings are usually spent gaming or browsing Reddit. I'm single and love participating in discussions about game strategies, especially when it comes to open-world games like Saints Row. I'm not a big fan of politics and prefer to discuss topics that are more light-hearted and entertaining. I usually log on to Reddit after work around 6 PM CST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, which is where my interest in numbers and patterns comes from. I've also taught myself a lot about data analytics through online courses and forums. My passion for gaming began in my early teens, and I've been following gaming communities and updates religiously ever since.
